device_name: ES2 Percutaneous Thoracolumbar Pedicle Screw Set

specs.Features: K-Wire Cannulated , Polyaxial Head , Percutaneous Screw , Extended Reduction Head Tabs

description: The Stryker ES2 is a minimally invasive percutaneous system for thoracolumbar fixation. It utilizes blade towers with built in 15mm of reduction threads and features a polyaxial head with a six-point star drive thread with cannulated screws for K-wire.
features: Options for short and long blade
